claims.scope: battleElo rating update in EloCalculator using Elo.ratingChange

preconditions.text: battleElo calls Elo.ratingChange(eloB, eloA, ...) which returns a rating change amount change and a direction flag negative for one party after a single battle.; When negative is true, eloB's rating should decrease (e.g., eloB lost or performed below expectations).; When negative is false, eloB's rating should increase.; The rating change and direction flag are derived from a series of battle results passed to battleElo.
preconditions.derivation: 未能生成忠实的形式化前提。

safety.text: When negative is true, eloB must decrease by change and eloA must increase by change; when negative is false, eloB must increase and eloA must decrease, so the better-performing party's rating does not decrease.
safety.derivation: 未能为该影响生成忠实的安全关系。

effects.text: Protocol functionality relying on the Elo ratings (rankings, matchmaking, reward distribution, eligibility) operates on entirely incorrect data, causing distorted rankings, unfair matchmaking and mismatched rewards.
effects.derivation: 该影响保留在覆盖清单中，但未生成形式化谓词。
